IGUI_HTT_Opt_Audio_Desc: Adjusts local playback volume for HTT event sounds. Does not change zombie attraction noise.
IGUI_HTT_Opt_EventVolume_tt: Client-local volume for helicopter event sounds.
Sandbox_BalancePreset_tooltip: Quickly applies a tuned set of values for toxic and attack events.
Sandbox_DefaultEventDurationHours_toolti: Default duration in game hours when HTT starts an event.
Sandbox_DisableEventsDuringSleep_tooltip: When enabled, automatic event starts and toxic ambient loops are paused while players are sleeping or time is fast-forwarded.
Sandbox_EnableEventAirBombardment_toolti: Allows the air bombardment helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventDownedHeli_tooltip: Allows the downed helicopter crash event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventEMIInterference_toolt: Allows the electromagnetic interference (EMI) event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventFuelReclamation_toolt: Allows the fuel reclamation helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventHostileAttack_tooltip: Allows the hostile helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventIncendiarySweep_toolt: Allows the incendiary sweep event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventMilitaryVehicleStrike: Allows the military vehicle strike helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventPropagandaBroadcast_t: Allows the propaganda broadcast event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSmokeCurtainEvent_too: Allows the smoke curtain event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSniperCover_tooltip: Allows the sniper cover event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSupportAttack_tooltip: Allows the support attack helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventSurveillanceEvent_too: Allows the surveillance event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventToxic_tooltip: Allows the toxic helicopter event to run.
Sandbox_EnableEventUAVScan_tooltip: Allows the UAV scan event to run and broadcast zombie density reports by radio.
Sandbox_EnableFixedDailyEventHour_toolti: When enabled, automatic HTT events ignore cooldowns and try to start once every in-game day at the fixed hour below.
Sandbox_EnableIncendiarySweepPlayerRisk_: If enabled, incendiary sweeps can land in a random range near players and may hit them, but are never directly targeted.
Sandbox_EnableMod_tooltip: Master switch for this mod. If disabled, HTT will not start events.
Sandbox_EnableRandomEventCooldown_toolti: When enabled, each vanilla-triggered HTT event uses a random cooldown between 6 hours and the value configured in Time Between Events.
Sandbox_EventCooldownHours_tooltip: In-game hours between vanilla-triggered HTT events. Valid range: 6 to 168. If random cooldown is enabled, this value becomes the upper bound of the random range.
Sandbox_EventWeightHostileAttack_tooltip: Relative chance weight for the hostile helicopter attack event.
Sandbox_EventWeightSupportAttack_tooltip: Relative chance weight for the support attack event.
Sandbox_EventWeightToxic_tooltip: Relative chance weight for the toxic event.
Sandbox_FixedDailyEventHour_tooltip: In-game hour used by the fixed daily scheduler. Example: 9.50 = 09:30.
Sandbox_FuelReclamationDrainPercent_tool: Fuel percentage drained from loaded gas pumps when the fuel reclamation helicopter completes extraction.
Sandbox_HostileAttackHitChance_tooltip: Chance that a hostile burst lands a hit. Rolled once per burst.
Sandbox_MilitaryVehicleStrikeChance_tool: Chance that the military vehicle strike event will execute the attack when a valid military vehicle is found.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageCurvePower_tooltip: Damage curve exponent: higher values are gentler at low exposure and harsher near max.
Sandbox_ToxicDamageMinPerMinute_tooltip: Minimum per-minute toxic player damage once exposure passes the damage threshold.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerMinuteAtFullExposu: Base player health damage per minute when toxic exposure is at 100%.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePerTick_tooltip: Legacy zombie toxic damage per tick. Player toxic damage uses the per-minute options below.
Sandbox_ToxicDamagePreset_tooltip: Applies preset toxic damage/exposure and tick pacing values for quick balancing.
Sandbox_ToxicEventDurationHours_tooltip: Duration in game hours used by toxic helicopter events. Other events still use Event Duration Hours.
Sandbox_ToxicExposureGainPerMin_tooltip: How fast toxic exposure builds per minute while unprotected.
Sandbox_ToxicExtraDamagePerMinuteOnMaxEx: Small extra per-minute damage when exposure is very high (>= 90%).
Sandbox_ToxicMaxExposureHealthDamage_too: Legacy compatibility value. Prefer the per-minute toxic damage options below.
Sandbox_ToxicTickSeconds_tooltip: Seconds between each toxic damage/exposure server tick.
Sandbox_VanillaHookTriggerChance_tooltip: Chance (0-100) that a vanilla helicopter trigger starts an HTT event.
